title: The Worst Date
description: Recount your worst date in vivid detail to the group.
effect: Tell the story in 60 seconds or less. No backing out mid-story.

title: Celebrity Confession
description: Reveal your most embarrassing celebrity crush.
effect: Name the name. Defending your choice costs extra dignity, not points.

title: Compliment Bomb
description: Give the player to your left a heartfelt 30-second compliment.
effect: It must be sincere. Sarcasm voids the points.

title: Autocorrect Crimes
description: Confess your most devastating autocorrect fail.
effect: Reenactment encouraged.

title: Job Interview mime
description: Mime your current or last job until someone guesses it.
effect: No words, no sounds. First correct guess ends it.

title: Sing Your Last Text
description: Sing the last text you sent, to the tune of a nursery rhyme.
effect: You pick the tune. The table picks the volume.

title: The Haircut Story
description: Describe your most disastrous haircut in loving detail.
effect: Include how you tried to hide it.

title: Gallery Roulette
description: Show the third-most-recent photo in your camera roll.
effect: If it's genuinely private, take 2 SP instead — your call, no judgment. (Some judgment.)

title: Straight Face
description: Tell a true story while the other players do everything to make you laugh.
effect: Laugh and the table awards you nothing. Keep straight for 30 seconds to score.

title: Your Red Flag
description: Answer honestly: what is your red flag?
effect: One answer. Sincerity scores; deflection does not.

title: Search History
description: Announce the most innocent-sounding item in your search history.
effect: You choose which secret it innocently implies.

title: Impression Duel
description: Do your best impression of the player to your right.
effect: They award your points: generous (full) or merciless (half).

title: The Lie That Worked
description: Confess a lie you told that completely worked.
effect: Statute of limitations applies. Probably.

title: Niche Obsession
description: Pitch your weirdest hyperfixation like a TED talk.
effect: 30 seconds. Enthusiasm mandatory.

title: Ghost Award
description: Give an acceptance speech for 'Most Likely To Leave You On Read'.
effect: Thank at least two named people.

title: Typo Theatre
description: Dramatically read aloud the last typo you sent someone.
effect: Shakespearean delivery required.

title: Last Cried About
description: Admit the last thing that made you cry.
effect: Films count. Onions count. Feelings count most.

title: Worst Roommate
description: Describe your worst roommate's worst habit.
effect: If YOU were the worst roommate, extra points for confessing.

title: 15 Minutes
description: Declare exactly what you'd do with 15 minutes of fame.
effect: The table votes if you'd actually do it; if they believe you, full points.

title: Irrational Fear
description: Confess a fear you know is ridiculous and defend it anyway.
effect: Defense must last 20 seconds.

title: Last DM
description: Reveal the last DM you sent to someone in this room.
effect: If none, describe the last message you deleted before sending.

title: Phone Voice
description: Act out exactly how you answer the phone.
effect: Full performance, greeting included.

title: Weird Meal
description: Confess the strangest thing you have ever eaten — and whether you'd eat it again.
effect: Honesty about the 'again' is the whole game.

title: Honest Morning
description: Describe your real morning routine, no editing.
effect: Include the parts you'd cut from the movie version.

title: Fake Enjoyment
description: Admit something you pretend to enjoy.
effect: Name the people you've been lying to, generally.

title: Wave Back
description: Tell the group about the last time you waved at someone who wasn't waving at you.
effect: Physical reenactment of the slow recovery.

title: Guilty Playlist
description: Confess the song you love that you'd never admit to.
effect: You must hum 5 seconds of it.

title: Photo Pose
description: Recreate your most awkward photo pose for the table.
effect: Hold it for a 3-second count by the group.

title: Terrible Cinema
description: Reveal a genuinely bad movie you love and pitch it to the group.
effect: If anyone says 'okay actually that sounds good', +2 bonus AP.

title: Googled You
description: Admit the last thing you searched about someone in this room.
effect: Vague answers accepted at half points.

title: Reply-All Disaster
description: Tell your worst reply-all / wrong-recipient story.
effect: Include who saw it.

title: The Return
description: Explain the last thing you returned to a store and your excuse.
effect: Real excuse preferred; creative excuse scores same.

title: Kitchen Disaster
description: Describe your greatest cooking catastrophe.
effect: Fire alarms are worth bonus points in the telling.

title: Ringtone Reveal
description: Announce your ringtone and play (or hum) it.
effect: Silent mode counts as a confession: who are you hiding from?

title: Secret Superstition
description: Confess a superstition you secretly half-believe.
effect: You must admit what happens if you don't do it.

title: Dramatic Reading
description: Do a dramatic reading of a random text from your phone.
effect: Other players pick the emotion: rage, romance, or conspiracy.

title: Coin of Fate
description: Flip a coin: heads, you're radiant; tails, you're haunted.
effect: Call it in the air. Chickening out costs 1 SP.

title: The Cold Message
description: Claim you'd message a celebrity right now. The group decides if you would.
effect: Believe = success. Doubt = they're right.

title: Dice Diva
description: Roll the die: 4+ and your night is saved.
effect: Play with the real die. Chickening out costs 1 SP.

title: Double Bluff
description: Claim you'd give a speech at a stranger's wedding. Believable?
effect: The table votes on your credibility.

title: Hot Mic
description: Bet you can say something nice about every player in 20 seconds.
effect: Fail once and the risk fails.

title: Restaurant Roulette
description: Bet you'd eat whatever the player to your left orders next, sight unseen.
effect: The table believes you or it doesn't.

title: The Confidence Gamble
description: Claim you'd sing solo at open mic tonight.
effect: Believability check by the group.

title: Heads You Win
description: Flip for +4 AP — or 3 SP. Simple. Cruel.
effect: Call it in the air.

title: Interview Roleplay
description: Bet you can answer 'where do you see yourself in 5 years' without flinching.
effect: Roll: 4+ holds steady.

title: Group Chat Gamble
description: Bet you'd post 'good morning' to the family chat at 3am.
effect: The group judges your recklessness.

title: Fortune's Fool
description: Flip a coin for double or nothing on your composure.
effect: Heads: dignity. Tails: embarrassment.

title: The Honest Gamble
description: Bet you can take an honest compliment without deflecting.
effect: Player to your right compliments you; roll to hold it together (4+).

title: Text From the Past
description: Claim you'd reply 'hey, been a while?' to your most chaotic contact.
effect: Believability vote.

title: Dice of Doom
description: Roll: 4+ wins big, anything lower hurts.
effect: Straight odds, no skill.

title: The Dare-Adjacent Dare
description: Bet you'd hold a plank while answering a personal question.
effect: Roll 4+ to plank and answer.

title: Karaoke Russian Roulette
description: Bet you'd let the DJ pick your song, sight unseen.
effect: Believability check.

title: Comedy Set
description: Bet you can make the group laugh in one sentence, topic chosen by them.
effect: Roll 4+ to land the joke.

title: The Ex-Files
description: Claim you'd watch your ex's story without a burner account.
effect: The group votes on whether that's plausible.

title: Budget Betrayal
description: Bet you'd admit your salary to this table if asked directly.
effect: Believability vote; lying here is the point of the game.

title: One-Take Wonder
description: Bet you can confess an embarrassing story in one take, no pauses.
effect: Roll: 4+ is a clean take.

title: The Upgrade
description: Claim you'd upgrade your seat and then actually talk to the stranger next to you.
effect: Plausibility check by the table.

title: Chef's Gamble
description: Bet you'd order the daily special without asking what it is.
effect: Roll 4+ for the brave palate.

title: High-Stakes Hello
description: Claim you'd introduce yourself to a whole quiet train car.
effect: Believability vote.

title: The Final Toast
description: Bet you could improvise a wedding toast right now, no prep.
effect: Roll 4+ to stick the landing.

title: Zero Chill
description: Claim you'd watch horror alone with the lights off, tonight.
effect: Plausibility check.

title: The Regift
description: Bet you'd regift something this year and get away with it.
effect: Believability vote; charming liars win.

title: Dice & Despair
description: Roll the die. 4+ is triumph. 3- is lore you'll never live down.
effect: Pure odds.

title: Portrait Mode
description: Bet you'd let the group take a photo of you mid-laugh and keep it.
effect: Believability check.

title: The Group Photo Dare
description: Bet you'd propose the group photo 'jump shot'.
effect: Plausibility vote. You know who you are.

title: Fluent Nonsense

effect: Roll 4+ to commit.

title: The Blind Reply
description: Claim you'd let the group write one reply in your chat app.
effect: Believability vote.

title: Dance Floor Treaty
description: Bet you'd be first on an empty dance floor.
effect: Plausibility check.

title: Dice of Rebirth
description: Roll: 4+ and you're reborn cooler. Otherwise, so much cooler before.
effect: Simple odds, big feelings.

title: The Compliment Assassin
description: Bet you can compliment the most suspicious player and get a 'thank you'.
effect: Roll 4+ to charm.

title: Hotel Breakfast Hero
description: Claim you'd take (famously) extra croissants from the buffet.
effect: Plausibility vote; weak deniers exposed.

title: All or Nothing
description: Final-form gamble: double reward, double penalty.
effect: Coin flip. Legends and cautionary tales only.

title: Pickpocket
description: Steal 2 AP from the target.
effect: Target loses 2 AP; you gain 2 AP.

title: Shame Bell
description: Ring the shame bell: target gains 2 SP.
effect: Target gains 2 Shame.

title: Rumor Mill
description: Spread a tiny rumor: target loses 1 AP, you gain 1.
effect: Keep it silly. The rumor is the gift.

title: Awkward Tax
description: The leader pays: target loses 2 AP and gains 1 SP.
effect: Best used on whoever's winning.

title: Cringe Flu
description: Target catches secondhand embarrassment: 2 SP.
effect: Contagious at parties.

title: Energy Vampire
description: Drain 1 AP from target, gain 1 AP.
effect: You feel refreshed. They feel used.

title: Group Photo photobomb

effect: You will appear in the background of all their memories.

title: Screenshot

effect: Of what? Doesn't matter. It exists now.

title: Red Exclamation

effect: 'Oh no, that wasn't for you.'

title: Credit Thief
